known_before_registration: hybrid-shift-v2-substitution (PR #40): FAIL, 0/20 primary joint pass, token-order-share the sole blocker (mean 0.0234 vs 0.02 ceiling); a same-day correction found this is a coupling x novelty-mechanism interaction, not an independent coupling effect (PR #40 addendum)

coupling causal concentration diagnostic (PR #44): coupling's causal firing event creates a real, substantial mutual-information gap at the token's position-0 character specifically -- mean MI 2.692 bits when coupling fired for a token vs 2.223 bits when it didn't, a direct, verified mechanism, not a proxy inference

position-0 unprotection diagnostic (PR #44, same branch): simply WIDENING the substitution top-up's eligible positions to include 0 (previously always excluded, positions range [1,n-1]) reduces order-share in the right direction but insufficiently (0.0234 -> 0.0227, still above the 0.02 ceiling) -- position 0 is eligible but rarely the position actually chosen in a uniform scan, diluting the effect

hypothesis under test, not yet verified: PRIORITIZING position 0 (trying it first whenever a substitution event fires, falling back to the original full scan only if no valid non-emitted alternative exists there) will touch position 0 far more often per substitution event than uniform eligibility did, and may close enough of the remaining order-share gap to pass -- at some risk to novelty-generation robustness, since restricting to one position first could occasionally fail to find a new token where the original multi-position scan would have succeeded
not_done_before_registration: No position-0-priority stream generated or scored
No parameter selected from any transformed outcome

nu_sub re-calibration (self-consistency-only, hapax-only, same methodology as prior hybrid designs) not yet run -- nu_shift stays fixed at 1.0, beta stays fixed at 0.5, same rationale as every prior design in this family

claim: Prioritizing position 0 in the substitution top-up (try it first when a substitution event fires; fall back to the original [1,n-1] scan only if position 0 has no valid non-emitted alternative) passes all six frozen criteria in at least 16 of 20 primary replicates.
honesty_precommitment: This is a reasoned extension of a confirmed mechanism (PR #44), not a guaranteed win: prioritizing one position could reduce the substitution mechanism's novelty-generation efficiency (fewer positions tried before falling back), which could hurt hapax or interact with H1/H2 in a way not yet observed. If this does not clear order-share sufficiently, or costs another criterion to do so, that will be reported plainly -- the position-0 unprotection diagnostic already showed the effect exists but is small at uniform eligibility; if prioritization also proves insufficient, that is real information about the size of this lever, not grounds to escalate to touching coupling itself.
base_mechanism: Identical to hybrid-shift-v2-substitution (PR #40): Naibbe cipher (voynich-units commit 956a7c4fc39981f4d116fa3f4edfccce6d065571) + boundary coupling (beta=0.5 fixed) + boundary-shift-v2 (nu_shift=1.0 fixed, its own established maximum). Only the substitution top-up's position-selection rule changes.

representation.roundtrip_required: collapse(expand(atom)) == atom for every atomic_alphabet symbol

position0_priority_substitution_topup.eligibility: token is still a repeat of something already emitted after the boundary-shift-v2 pass has run
position0_priority_substitution_topup.mechanism: when a substitution event fires, try position 0 FIRST (25 alternatives, same bigram-conditional/sparse-context/cold-start selection logic as before, but with no preceding-character context available for position 0 -- falls back to unigram frequency ordering there). If a valid non-emitted alternative is found at position 0, use it and stop. Only if NO alternative at position 0 succeeds, fall back to the original scan of positions [1, n-1] exactly as in hybrid-shift-v2-substitution.
position0_priority_substitution_topup.note: this is the only mechanical change from hybrid-shift-v2-substitution's own substitution_topup function

primary.note: frozen from pilot: smallest grid value, clears hapax floor with large margin (pilot mean 0.9232); every pilot dosage's order-share was at or under 0.02 in the no-coupling config, encouraging but not decisive since primary has coupling on -- see selfreview.md

baseline.note: identical to boundary-state-null's baseline; not rerun, reused by reference

edge_only.note: identical to boundary-state-null's edge_only; not rerun, reused by reference

configurations.pilot_calibration_rule: nu_sub chosen by a self-consistency-only pilot (3 seeds, hybrid_novelty_only config, beta=0, nu_shift=1.0 fixed) targeting hapax_share_of_types in [0.65, 0.75], selecting the SMALLEST nu_sub that lands in-band -- same rule and grid as every prior hybrid design ({0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.1}). If, as in the original hybrid-shift-v2-substitution pilot, every tested value overshoots the band substantially (hapax already saturated from shift-v2 alone), the same disclosed deviation applies: select the smallest grid value, since it already clears the actual six-criteria floor (0.65) with margin, and order-share is explicitly NOT used to select nu_sub even if a different value looks more favorable in the pilot data.

boundary.note: reused from boundary-state-null's edge_only vs baseline comparison, not recomputed

novelty.note: checked against hybrid_novelty_only vs baseline, same convention as every prior hybrid design

primary_verdict.pass: Both manipulation checks succeed and at least 16 of 20 primary replicates pass all six criteria
primary_verdict.fail: Both manipulation checks succeed and fewer than 16 of 20 primary replicates pass all six criteria

execution_embargo: Do not implement the transformation beyond the pilot-calibration step, or calculate any primary/control/sensitivity outcome, until the self-review pass documented in the accompanying log is complete.
